## Corrections, warnings and limitations

- The first native fixture parser assumed a single JSON object; VibeVM emits
  multiple event objects followed by the result. The helper now reads that event
  stream. No common projector defect or live-model failure is inferred.
- A fixture's offline local-registry update did not discover the newly staged
  synthetic version. The final qualification uses the documented existing
  direct-Git distribution/update route against a disposable local repository,
  which passed. Offline registry discovery refresh is not qualified by this
  result. Initial CLI flag placement/full-SHA invocations were corrected before
  successful native generation. No blind remote retry or frozen-tag replacement.
- Common maintenance uses INDEX schema 1, lock schema 7 and slot receipt schema 1.
  Missing indexed files fail even with unknown applicability; conditions are not
  evaluated or adopted. Matching Git objects/URLs/hashes cannot authenticate
  owner acceptance or repository provenance. Caller verification remains required.
- Updates validate all targets before writing and preserve unknown/modified
  output, but do not claim transactional multi-file I/O. Ordinary Git recovery
  and moving useful changes into custom source are the supported repair path.
  Live-export `fenced` comparison supports one complete fence; use raw export
  for content with nested fences. Exact whitespace differences are real diffs.
- The one title call returned the requested name; persisted readback exposes an
  ellipsized title, so full exact persistence is unavailable. Serving model/effort
  telemetry is **UNAVAILABLE**. Neither limitation changes execution authority.
- Check annotations must be read separately from primary logs. Final native
  workflow/job/check/annotation identities, completeness and dispositions are
  recorded in the canonical Outcome. Unsupported UI-only/pre-execution warnings
  are not acquired or asserted absent.
- Real ChatGPT loading, field application/readback, spontaneous review depth,
  role enforcement, active-blocker recovery, Sources upload/addressability/freshness
  and repeated model reliability remain **UNQUALIFIED**. Owner-export comparisons
  are synthetic/offline text tests; no actual live field was supplied. Prior
  owner-reported experiments remain historical, with original limitations.
- All Step 1–4 artifact directories and source protocol/compact-boot bytes are
  preserved. Native version-slot replacement is ordinary candidate materialization;
  frozen historical registry/source versions remain. No new shared topic is adopted.
